reviews.text:
We chose this veterinary hospital to accompany our beloved Boubou on his final farewell.

We always received a warm and caring welcome. France, at reception, is wonderful, as is the entire staff, who showed such humanity and gentleness during what was a particularly painful time for us.

The prices are also very reasonable, which is far from negligible in these circumstances.

Thank you for prioritizing people and animal welfare over profit. In moments of great vulnerability, it is invaluable to encounter professionals who demonstrate such compassion, where other establishments might give the impression of prioritizing financial gain.

Thank you for making this final goodbye a little less difficult. We will always be deeply grateful to your team and for the support you provided, allowing our Boubou to pass away with dignity and respect.
Very expensive just a consolatation fee is 115$ and at the end I did not get the info I had to get but I still had to pay. Never again. So for that I'm giving a 2stars.

Terrible service: you go there with your pet suffering from some kind of ailment, it costs $300 each time, and the problem isn't even solved. Plus, they don't do a blood test to see if they can detect anything. I called back to express my dissatisfaction, and the receptionist had absolutely no patience, just said, "Sacrama, that's enough," and picked up the phone. What professionalism! In short, they only want to make money, and your pet isn't important to them...
A huge thank you to the entire team at the Henri-Bourassa Veterinary Hospital! From the warm welcome by Ms. France at reception to the excellent care provided by the veterinarian. THANK YOU 💗 …

Today I said goodbye to my companion, my confidant of the last 16 years. My Pantouf passed away peacefully to his final rest. I want to emphasize the kindness and gentleness shown by the technician and the veterinarian there. Their care meant so much to me during these difficult times. A special thank you to the kind-hearted receptionist. Your empathy and kind words comforted me with the beauty of humanity. ❤️ You are a wonderful person!

I needed a vet for my dog's allergies. My usual vet was on sick leave. The service was excellent. Dr. Chartrand was attentive, professional, and compassionate. I was very satisfied. I would definitely go back if needed.

My dog ​​developed a hot spot and, within a few days, he couldn't sleep. France was very attentive and understanding of my distress at seeing him suffer. Despite a very busy afternoon at the clinic, she did everything she could to ensure I quickly received the appropriate medication to relieve his pain (of course, the vet had seen my dog ​​a few days earlier when the problem first appeared).

Thank you to France and Dr. Bourget for their help and kindness.

A huge thank you to Dr. Chartrand and his entire team for the extraordinary care provided to Yoda. We felt listened to, understood, and supported from beginning to end. Their gentleness, patience, and professionalism made all the difference.

Yoda was treated like family, and that is priceless. I wholeheartedly recommend this team. He is now in excellent health!
